description: Rubik's cube last-layer algorithm sets used by the K2 cube trainer: full OLL (57 cases), full PLL (21), the two-look beginner subsets, full ZBLL, and Roux CMLL (42 cases plus a two-look subset; CMLL algorithms only need to solve the corners and keep both 1x2x3 blocks). Each case returns its primary algorithm plus alternates, with sources and finger-trick notes where recorded. Every algorithm in these sets is verified against a cube simulator by the repo's audit script (app/cube/scripts/audit-algorithms.mjs), run before data changes land. Filter by `case_id` or `group`; omit both for the set's structure and levels.
name: get_cube_algorithms
